task: deploy and configure the system in a new execution environment
target: system execution environment and runtime architecture
goal: understand required runtime environments, software artifacts, execution and storage locations, communication channels, and technologies/runtime dependencies between the application and the database
source_goal: I am a DevOps engineer. I need to deploy and configure the system in a new execution environment. Before preparing the deployment, I need to understand which runtime environments and software artifacts are required, where the application and its data are executed and stored, and how the main runtime elements communicate with each other. I also need to identify the technologies and runtime dependencies involved in the communication between the application and the database.
